events.title: QDMI Meet-up
events.description: Everyone interested in QDMI is invited. We will discuss how to use it, explain its features, and outline future directions. This round is meant as an open exchange format to bring various stakeholders together.

events.title: Unitary Foundation meet-up
events.description: Come discuss with us about open source quantum software and research! We will provide demos of the tools developed and maintained by Unitary Foundation (clifft, mitiq, ucc, emlint, …), and give you an opportunity to give a try to our QEC challenge, an autoresearch framework to find and validate better qLDPC codes.
events.audience: Researchers, software developers, … No prior knowledge required.

events.title: Austrian Quantum Ecosystem
events.description: What better place for quantum folks from Austria to meet than the MQSF? We will seize the opportunity to connect in person, network, and exchange ideas.
events.audience: Everyone interested in the Austrian Quantum Ecosystem.

events.title: Quantum Experiment Tracking
events.description:
Has the compiler produced a different circuit from what you expected? Want to know which transpiler pass caused the change?

Join us to explore a tool that makes Qiskit compiler passes visible. We’ll demonstrate how to use it to track circuit changes and compilation times, and discuss future directions for the tool.

The meet-up is also an invitation to share your experiences and needs around quantum experiment tracking.
events.audience: Application developers and researchers curious about compiler inner workings.
events.organizers: Vlad Stirbu, Otso Kinanen, Mahee Gamage

events.title: FullStaQD: Developing an End-End Software Stack for Quantum Computing
events.description: We present FullStaQD the flaqship project within QC Next Europe's biggest quantum computing software project. Within the project we develop multiple software building blocks across the software stack to allow the implementation of various end-to-end stacks for specific industry use cases.
events.audience:
Software developers from all layers and anyone who is interested in getting involved. We are always open for exchange and collaborations and invite the community to proactively contribute to this endeavour.
More information @ fullstaqd.de

events.title: QEC software
events.description: Let’s talk about gaps in the tooling landscape for QEC & FTQC development and debugging

events.title: ArQade Tournament
events.description:
Come and check out the all-new Munich Quantum ArQade machine - Retro games with a Quantum touch!
Let's see who's best at Quantum Pong ;)

events.title: Quantum Computing Use Cases
events.description:
Exchange of ideas to categorize and prioritize Use Cases based on:
▪︎ (Cross) Business Sectors
▪︎ Problem complexity
▪︎ Added Value
▪︎ QC, QC & HPC
▪︎ Role of AI
▪︎ other factors you think should be considered

events.title: Qiskit meet-up
events.description: Do you have a pending PR in Qiskit GitHub? Would you like an explanation about a change in the roadmap? Do you have a project written on top of Qiskit that you would like to show? Bring your feedback and questions about Qiskit!

events.title: ConAD-QC (SPP 2514): Dynamic Circuit Compilation – Meet-up
events.description: Everyone interested in ConAD-QC (https://www.spp2514.kit.edu/projects/p13.php) is welcome. We will give a demonstration of our ongoing work on dynamic quantum circuit compilation and related design automation techniques, followed by an informal discussion.

events.title: jeff Meet-up
events.description: We will discuss the current status of the jeff format and what we have planned for the future.
events.audience: jeff contributors and anyone interested in joining.
events.organizers: Daniel Haag, Damian Rovara, Lukas Burgholzer

events.title: neQxt career meetup
events.description: Chat about career perspectives and open positions at neQxt

events.title: PsiQ FTQC Application Development
events.description: Chat with the PsiQ software team about FTQC algorithm development

events.title: Microseconds Matter: Bringing Low-Latency Control Up the Software Stack
events.description: How can software developers access the full potential of low-latency quantum control hardware? This community session combines demonstrations and open discussion around quantum software stacks, Qiskit integration, embedded calibration workflows, and real-time parameter updates. Join us to discuss the future of software-defined quantum experimentation and feedback.
events.audience: Researchers and developers working on quantum software, quantum control, calibration, and real-time quantum computing workflows.

events.title: Graphix meet-up
events.description: Introduction to measurement-based computation (MBQC) and the basics of Graphix.
events.audience: Anyone interested in learning and contributing!

events.title: TQEC - Compiling to a fault tolerant processor
events.description: I will be presenting the TQEC toolset with some use-cases to define a computation, its representation and perform some simulations on it.
events.audience: Anyone interested in an introduction to the Surface Code and the TQEC project.

events.title: QML - Boom or Bust?
events.description: What can quantum machine learning actually do today, and how does it compare to classical ML? Let's get together for an informal discussion about recent developments, practical limitations, and open questions in QML. Bring your questions, insights, and perspectives to the conversation
events.audience: Anyone interested in or curious about QML

events.title: OpenQARP hands-on
events.description:
Learn how to install OpenQarp, build and run your first quantum circuit using our OSS SDK

https://github.com/OpenQARP/openqarp

events.title: Haiqu - Meet-up
events.description: Come and meet our team to chat about how Haiqu SDK and Agentic OS can help speed up your quantum algorithm research and improve the hardware results.
events.audience: Everyone working in quantum software, applications or R&D is welcome
